entries.rationale: Winterthur is independently validated along positive path order. The source catalog contains exactly two opposing main-carriageway lane1 detectors, explicitly labelled Zürich and Winterthur. The Zürich centre passes distance, road projection and local bearing checks (-0.92); only the large settlement extent crosses the station. The opposing lane is therefore negative along this same road path. This is a source-evidence inference for this pinned station, not surveyed vehicle movement or a relaxation of the general settlement-extent gate.

geometryReview.note: The official road-axis extract places the station on the single ZH 1 axis, southwest of the Bassersdorf counter. Local path order and the independently resolved Winterthur direction agree.
